title: Maps from the Cech chain complex of a family into a presheaf are the Cech complex
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the complex of maps from the Cech chain complex Z_{U, bullet} of a family U = {U_i -> U} into an abelian presheaf F with the Cech complex of U with coefficients in F, functorially in F (statement lines 972-1002). The proof is short but not a hypothesis-checking step: it expands a map out of a direct sum of representable presheaves into F into a product of values F(U_{i_0} x_U ... x_U U_{i_p}), displayed as two equalities, and then has to match the alternating sign convention of the differentials of Z_{U, bullet} with the sign convention of the Cech differential (proof lines 1006-1021). What makes the statement usable later is exactly the functoriality in F asserted in its last clause. The claim is H2: one adjunction computation whose content is the degree and sign bookkeeping.
